description: Clip supplied segments to a simple concave polygon, retaining source identity and every positive-length interior or boundary interval.

provenance.relationship: Independent clipping dependency; hatch construction/decorations remain consumers, source incomplete intersection checks and exactly-two-hit behavior deliberately corrected.

behavior.input: Exactly polygon,segments,maxWork,maxOutputSegments in a passive record. Validate record/keys, polygon list and each finite pair in order, segments list and every finite quadruple in order, maxWork, maxOutputSegments. All numeric carriers are finite binary64 and never bool; integer limits require exact integral values in schema domain. Java accepts Byte,Short,Integer,Long,Float,Double only. Normalize signed zero. Complete all static validation before work/topology. No implicit defaults or closed-vertex duplicate removal.
behavior.work: V=polygon.length,S=segments.length. Compute W=V*V+S*(8*V*V+16*V+8) in exact integers. WORK_LIMIT_EXCEEDED iff W>maxWork, before topology testing or generated output allocation. W is a conservative abstract geometry allowance, not milliseconds, bytes or literal bigint operation count. Empty sources still pay V². Big-integer costs and host allocation are not covered by a timing guarantee.
behavior.polygon: At least3 distinct vertices, implicit last-to-first closure, exact nonzero signed area. Reject repeated vertices including a closing duplicate, adjacent collinear backtracking/overlap, or any nonadjacent edge contact/crossing. Straight collinear continuation is accepted. Either winding and concavity accepted. Exact dyadic arithmetic over input binary64 values; no epsilon. INVALID_POLYGON after work preflight.
behavior.clipping: Visit sources in input order. Zero-length source contributes nothing. For nonzero segment A+t(B-A), collect exact t=0,1 and each segment-edge intersection whose exact t,u are closed[0,1]. For collinear edges include edge endpoint t values within[0,1]. Parallel noncollinear edges add none. Sort/deduplicate exact rationals. Classify each open interval by its exact rational midpoint: retain iff inside or on boundary using exact even-odd containment. Merge neighboring retained intervals sharing an exact parameter. Never bridge a positive exterior interval. Point-only contacts are omitted.
behavior.rounding: Traverse merged intervals in increasing t. Before conversion check retained count against maxOutputSegments, otherwise OUTPUT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED with sourceIndex and intervalIndex. Convert each t and exact A+t(B-A) coordinate once to binary64 nearest-even, canonical +0. t=0/1 keeps the corresponding input endpoint except zero normalization. No intermediate binary64 interpolation. REPRESENTATION_COLLAPSE stages in order: parameter if rounded t0>=t1; endpoints if rounded coordinate pairs coincide; gap if previous returned interval of this source has rounded end>=current rounded start despite positive exact gap. Error detail sourceIndex,intervalIndex,stage. No returned partial result. Rounded endpoints may lie slightly off the exact boundary; centerline clipping does not constrain rendered stroke width. sourceIndex and intervalIndex are zero-based; intervalIndex counts merged retained intervals within that source before output conversion.
behavior.ownership: Retain owned packed coordinates, source indices and rounded parameter pairs only; do not retain inputs, exact rational temporaries or a renderer. Into reads allocate no result storage; At/export return detached data. No mutation or retained region session. Host allocation failure remains host failure.
behavior.access: size() counts retained segments. segmentAt(index) and segmentInto(index,output,offset) use4 doubles; intervalAt and intervalInto use2 doubles; sourceIndexAt returns integer. toValues returns output-schema keys in segments,sourceIndices,intervals order and detached nested lists. Index finite nonnegative safe integer<=9007199254740991; INVALID_INDEX before INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE before INVALID_OUTPUT. Java Object and long indices accepted; offsets required int. All destination slots remain unchanged on validation failure.
behavior.complexity: Correctness baseline O(V²+S*V²) geometric work plus sorting and exact arithmetic costs; O(V+S+K) retained input/output scale with per-source O(V) cut storage, K retained intervals. Packed segment quadruples bound maxOutputSegments by floor(INT_MAX/4); count ceilings are representational, not recommended use.

output_invariants: All three arrays have equal length<=maxOutputSegments. Ordered by source index then increasing source t; each t0<t1, with strict t gaps between distinct intervals of a source. Each segment has distinct finite endpoint pairs and canonical zero.

errors.OUTPUT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Next retained interval exceeds output allowance.
errors.REPRESENTATION_COLLAPSE: Positive exact interval or exterior gap cannot be represented distinctly; sourceIndex,intervalIndex,stage.

polygon.evidence: forms1 clipping boundary; simple-polygon domain is explicit design.

segments.evidence: Supplied strokes separate generation from clipping; private hatch/stroke transfer.

maxOutputSegments.evidence: Engineering memory/output allowance; no artistic range.

reproduction.scope: Private study only; no full forms1 recreation.
